subject: Optimize .clang-format and add enum/argument formatting options (#3905)
reason: The change only edits the .clang-format configuration and reformats existing code to match it: enum declarations in cluster_legacy.c, defrag.c and server.h and a struct initializer list in db.c are reflowed onto multiple lines. Every edit is whitespace and line-break only; no identifier, value, or logic changes, so there is no runtime behaviour to test and no scenario is needed.
